page.notes: Printed in three columns, all read top to bottom, left to right. The first line of the left column and the last line of the middle column are printed as shown. Greek words are copied from the scan with [?] where the letters are not fully clear. "uer[?]larius" is doubtful: the scan is blurred and may read "uersarius". The Greek in "Romani pontifices" and "Salutis nostræ" is small and uncertain. Printed "Sanctorum" and "Sancti" entries with references "68.6" and "7.b.129.b" are kept as printed. The "R 4" signature and the "Satan" catchword are at the foot of the right column.
